title: Put AICR inside your Go app

scenes.heading: A portal needs the deployable files
scenes.sub: Turn a form into a usable configuration
voice: An engineer chooses EKS, H100, Ubuntu, and training in your platform portal.
The Go application needs the resolved recipe and the files its deployment pipeline expects.

scenes.heading: Resolve inside the Go process
voice: Import the public AICR Go client and pass in typed criteria.
ResolveRecipe gives the portal a recipe it can inspect, including selected components and their configuration.

scenes.heading: Render the chosen output
scenes.sub: Reuse the recipe you just resolved
voice: Pass that recipe and your deployer options into MakeBundle.
The library generates deployment artifacts in the same process, ready for the chosen deployment tool to consume.

scenes.heading: Return something useful
scenes.sub: Make the result visible in the portal
voice: The portal can show the selected versions and hand the bundle to its deployment pipeline.
Your application uses ordinary Go calls for the recipe, bundle, and errors.

viewer: Go developer building a platform portal
payoff: Follow one typed platform request through ResolveRecipe and MakeBundle to deployer artifacts returned by a Go app.
